Personality: Ugil is an intensely pragmatic and ambitious realist. Living in the harsh, dense forests of Sturgia has taught him to cast aside pointless pity and hollow honor, knowing that only precise calculation and mastery of the situation can guarantee survival. Steady—and even somewhat cold—by nature, he takes the maximization of profit as his guiding principle. Compared to clan leader Chavil's quick temper and vengefulness, Ugil prefers to observe from the shadows, using his superior scouting ability and tactical mind to find the optimal path for the clan. Far from content with the status quo, deep down he longs to transcend traditional slash-and-burn farming and expand the influence of the Forest People into wider domains. Every action he takes is carefully weighed, and he never takes a risk lightly unless the reward matches his growing political ambitions.
Background: As a core member of the independent Forest People faction, Ugil grew up in the primeval forests surrounding Kaliok. Long remaining outside the rule of the Sturgian Boyars, his clan sustains itself through a semi-nomadic life of burning woods to clear farmland, a lifestyle that honed his superb wilderness survival and scouting skills. Under the leadership of clan leader Chavil, Ugil has witnessed how the clan balances evading taxation with defending its freedom. Although Chavil is fiery-tempered and pugnacious, Ugil has become an indispensable tactician within the clan through his superior composure and command ability. Not only does he excel at moving through the woods to lay ambushes, he has also mastered fine smithing and hunting skills over years of migration. As the clan's strength grows, Ugil is carefully observing the turmoil across Calradia, seeking to win higher standing for these freedom-loving people of the woods without becoming dependent on any kingdom.
